## Serpent Alchemist (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
Serpentman alchemist 9  
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (shapechanger)  
**Init** +11; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +22  

**Defense**

 **AC** 27, touch 16, flat-footed 21 (+7 armor, +5 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)  
**hp** 246 (15 HD; 6d10+9d8+99)  
**Fort** +14, **Ref** +18, **Will** +12; +6 vs. poison  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects, poison, paralysis; **SR** 16  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +1 dagger +21/+16/+11 (1d4+8/19–20), bite +19 (1d6+7 plus poison)  
**Special Attacks** bomb 17/day (5d6+8 fire, DC 22)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th; concentration +8)  

 At will—ventriloquism 1/day—blur, dominate person (DC 18), major image (DC 16), mirror image, suggestion (DC 16)  

 **Alchemist Extracts Prepared** (CL 9th)  

 3rd—cure serious wounds, displacement, fly, gaseous form, nondetection  
2nd—barkskin, cure moderate wounds, detect thoughts (DC 20), invisibility, see invisibility, undetectable alignment  
1st—cure light wounds, disguise self, expeditious retreat, identify, jump, shield, true strike  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 25, **Con** 23, **Int** 26, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 29  
**Feats** Brew Potion, Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Spring Attack, [Throw Anything](../../rules/feats/throw-anything.md), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (dagger)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (dagger); Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +22, Bluff +18, Craft (alchemy) +30, Disguise +18, Knowledge (arcana) +26, Knowledge (history) +23, Knowledge (local) +23, Knowledge (nature) +20, Perception +22, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +26, Stealth +16, Use Magic Device +21; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Craft (alchemy)  
**Languages** Abyssal, Aklo, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Elder Thing, Mi-Go, Serpentman  
**SQ** alchemy (alchemy crafting +9, identify potions), change self (alter self, any humanoid), discoveries (acid bomb, fast bombs, precise bombs [8 squares], sticky poison [8 strikes]), gifted spellcaster, mutagen (+4/–2, +2 natural, 90 minutes), poison use, serpent’s strike, swift alchemy, swift poisoning Combat Gear potions of cure light wounds (4), potion of invisibility; Other Gear +4 studded leather, +1 dagger, amulet of natural armor +1
